name: PNG to JPG
summary: Convert PNG images to JPG with quality control and a background color for transparency — locally.
description: Upload a PNG, choose JPEG quality and a fill color for transparent areas, preview the result, and download a .jpg. Conversion uses your browser only; nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: What happens to transparency?
faqs.answer: JPEG has no alpha channel. Transparent pixels are filled with the background color you pick (white by default).

faqs.question: Is the file uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I convert other formats?
faqs.answer: This tool is PNG → JPG. Use Image Resizer to change size or export other formats.
